You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 2301c54fa91379f5fe2458e28ed902aff5cf12d2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Yu Watanabe <watanabe.yu+github@gmail.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jan 2019 09:42:35 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] network/wireguard: fixes sending wireguard peer settings

This fixes a bug introduced by e1f717d4a02e15ae11a191dd4962b2f4d117678d.

Fixes #11579.
---
 src/network/netdev/wireguard.c | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/network/netdev/wireguard.c b/src/network/netdev/wireguard.c
index 1efd8863f6..dd239f79a8 100644
--- a/src/network/netdev/wireguard.c
+++ b/src/network/netdev/wireguard.c
@@ -109,7 +109,7 @@ static int wireguard_set_peer_one(NetDev *netdev, sd_netlink_message *message, c
         if (r < 0)
                 goto cancel;
 
-        if (!start) {
+        if (!*mask_start) {
                 r = sd_netlink_message_append_data(message, WGPEER_A_PRESHARED_KEY, &peer->preshared_key, WG_KEY_LEN);
                 if (r < 0)
                         goto cancel;
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by a logical error in the condition that checks whether to append the preshared key to the netlink message. The original condition checked if the variable `start` was false, which was incorrect. The fix changes the condition to check if the dereferenced value of `mask_start` is false instead, ensuring that the preshared key is only appended when the appropriate condition is met. This change corrects the logic for sending wireguard peer settings.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by a logical error in the condition that checks whether to append the preshared key to the netlink message. The original condition checked if the variable `start` was false, which was incorrect. The fix changes the condition to check if the dereferenced value of `mask_start` is false instead, ensuring that the preshared key is only appended when the appropriate condition is met. This change corrects the logic for sending wireguard peer settings.
